source: Activation checkpointing deliberately saves fewer intermediate activations and recomputes parts of the forward pass during backward, trading extra computation for lower activation memory. That is a training-system strategy around the block, not a change to the mathematical function the block represents.
zh: 激活检查点故意保存更少的中间激活，并在向后过程中重新计算部分前向传递，以额外的计算换取较低的激活内存。这是围绕块的训练系统策略，而不是对块所代表的数学函数的改变。
